packages.description: Hubitat driver for Moonraker/Klipper 3D printers. Monitor print status, temperatures, and progress via live dashboard tiles. packages.name: Reolink Integration
packages.description: Discovers and manages Reolink cameras, doorbells, NVRs, and Home Hubs over the local HTTP API. Motion/AI detection, doorbell button press, snapshots, PTZ with preset recall, spotlight, night vision, siren, and battery %. No cloud account required.
